svg.title: Mutation types on the same toy coding sequence
svg.text: Point mutations and a frameshift on the same coding sequence
Invented 18-nt coding sequence. Red letter: changed base. Bold amino acid: changed residue. Grey: not translated.
GAG to GTG: Glu to Val
TGG to TAG: Trp to Stop
Molecular consequence only: whether a change matters clinically is a separate question (see the Mutation note).
